title: Food-Bank Stock Rotation Dashboard
originalRequest: Implement the First-Expired, First-Out (FEFO) automated stock rotation and alert mechanism to reduce food waste.
latestMessage: Implement the First-Expired, First-Out (FEFO) automated stock rotation and alert mechanism to reduce food waste.

steps.title: FEFO Sorting Algorithm and Expiration Alert Database Integration
steps.instruction: Implement database queries to sort inventory by closest expiration date and generate automated alerts for items expiring within 7 days. This is the second attempt by agent joker-codex to resolve schema compatibility issues on the expiration tracking table, which has been flagged as an easy task but remains blocked due to missing database write privileges.
steps.acceptance: The api/v1/stock/rotation endpoint returns inventory ordered by expiration date, and unit tests verify that trigger flags are correctly raised for items expiring within 7 days.
